mode: built-in image_gen; reference-guided repaint; opaque background
provenance: World of ClaudeCraft project-generated artwork, based on project-owned scene layouts and concept art. Replaces the previous loading-screen visuals without changing URLs or rotation behavior.
referencesNote: Paths are relative to the repository; ../bible is the maintainer's project-owned concept library. Target references mean the pre-refresh originals, backed up locally in tmp/loading-art-refresh/originals; generated set-style reference is kept in the local masters folder. Do not feed the repainted shipping targets back as the historical original reference.

export.settings: Sharp: centered cover resize, opaque flatten, sRGB, quality 86 decreasing by 2 only if over budget; WebP effort 6, JPEG mozjpeg. No runtime code changes.
